scenarios.title: Cold Start Native & JS Stall
scenarios.description: Injects a 450ms main-thread sync block in Native init and 300ms RN first-frame delay.
scenarios.expected_signal: startup (3-stage P90 spike in native_init_ms & first_frame_ms)

scenarios.title: Native Feed Scroll Jank + Main-Thread Stall Stack
scenarios.description: Triggers synchronous bitmap decoding during list scroll on Android/iOS native Feed.
scenarios.expected_signal: fluency_window (jank_rate > 8%, same-window stall stack auto-symbolicated to FeedImageDecoder)

scenarios.title: RN Streaming Reader JS LongTask Storm
scenarios.description: Executes heavy synchronous markdown/JSON parsing on the Hermes JS thread.

scenarios.title: Native/JS Callback Retention Leak
scenarios.description: Retains large decoded image buffers & uncleaned JS callbacks across screen navigations.

scenarios.title: Obfuscated Native Crash, JS Error & ANR
scenarios.description: Emits obfuscated Android R8, iOS address, and Hermes JS bundle crashes with breadcrumbs.
scenarios.expected_signal: crash / anr (auto-symbolicated to exact source file & line via uploaded build symbols)

scenarios.title: Slow TLS / HTTP 502 Storm
scenarios.description: Configures mock-api chaos (latency + 502 errors) and records both API denominator & transport stages.
scenarios.expected_signal: network_summary + network_transport (success rate drop + TLS/TTFB waterfall spike + alert webhook)
